info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Upper Onkaparinga River above Verdun, Onkaparinga River at Woodside and Onkaparinga River at Oakbank
info.description:
Minor flooding is occurring at Oakbank and moderate flooding is possible at Woodside.
The Onkaparinga River at Woodside is currently at 2.21 m and rising, with minor flooding. The Onkaparinga River at Woodside may peak near the moderate flood level (2.40 m) Monday evening.
The Onkaparinga River at Oakbank is currently at 1.17 m and rising, with minor flooding. The Onkaparinga River at Oakbank may reach around 1.50 m Sunday evening, with minor flooding. Further rises are possible.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.ses.sa.gov.au/incidents-and-warnings/incidents-and-warnings-map/.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
